verdict.rationale: Shopify Agentic Commerce is a SaaS platform that handles agent and buyer data, so a training-data opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any control over whether data is used for AI model training. The docs cover catalog, cart, checkout, orders, profiles and auth tiers, none of which address this.
